events.title: Pass the Passkey: A Novel Attack Surface in Passwordless Authentication
events.summary: This article analyzes new attack classes, dubbed "Pass-ta-key," "Silver Pass-ta-key," and "Golden Pass-ta-key," against passwordless authentication, specifically targeting Google's synced passkey ecosystem. These attacks demonstrate how malware on a compromised endpoint can exploit onboarding, recovery, and device trust workflows to take over passkey-protected accounts, enabling authentication without user interaction, bypassing user verification, and even extracting private keys. The research emphasizes that while passkeys enhance security, their implementation can still create novel attack surfaces, necessitating strict validation and hardened recovery flows to maintain their intended security benefits.

events.title: Hamilton Wealth LLC Purchases 13,863 Shares of Palo Alto Networks, Inc. $PANW

events.title: Who Owns Snapchat?
events.summary: Snapchat, initially launched in 2011 by Evan Spiegel, Bobby Murphy, and Reggie Brown, is now technically owned by its parent company, Snap Inc. While Snap Inc. is publicly traded, its founders, Spiegel and Murphy, retain overwhelming voting control due to their significant holdings in Class B and Class C stock. Major asset management and investment firms like FMR, Vanguard, JP Morgan, and BlackRock Inc. hold substantial shares in Snap Inc., but do not hold the majority voting power.

events.title: ATIF Holdings to acquire GoldCoin Labs for $20 million
events.summary: ATIF Holdings Limited (NASDAQ:AUC) has announced a definitive agreement to acquire GoldCoin Labs Limited for $20 million. This acquisition will make GoldCoin a wholly-owned subsidiary of ATIF, with the payment made in ATIF ordinary shares to GoldCoin's sole shareholder. GoldCoin is developing Metra Gold (GOLDM), a tokenized digital representation of physical gold, and the transaction follows ATIF's prior exploration of the bitcoin sector.

The company also maintains a quarterly dividend of $0.42 per share, indicating a 1.4% annual yield.

events.title: Could Oracle Go Bankrupt – Really?
events.summary: Oracle's aggressive pursuit of hyperscale cloud dominance, particularly in AI infrastructure, has led to a significant increase in capital expenditures and debt, raising concerns about its financial stability. While bankruptcy isn't the base case, the article highlights the potential risks if AI spending slows and anchor tenants default on their commitments, putting a strain on Oracle's ability to manage its high capital intensity and financial leverage. The shift from a highly profitable legacy software business to a capital-hungry infrastructure company has transformed Oracle's risk profile, making credit risk a primary concern for investors.

events.title: Commvault's backup scan expected to check files before recovery
events.summary: Commvault has announced an integration of its Threat Scan workflows with Google Threat Intelligence to enhance recovery validation after cyberattacks. This collaboration aims to combine Mandiant, VirusTotal, and Google threat data with new inline hash-based scanning and layered inspection, facilitating faster and cleaner recoveries. The new features will allow organizations to identify compromised recovery points and receive actionable threat context, strengthening Commvault’s AI-enabled Synthetic Recovery capability.

events.title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Price Forecast: Up 14% From Post-Earnings Low, Eyes $364 Resistance at 17x P/E
events.summary: Alphabet (GOOGL) stock has rebounded 14% from its post-earnings low, trading near $360 and breaking key moving averages. events.title: Amazon Joins Elite List of Stocks to Top $3 Trillion in Value
events.summary: Amazon.com Inc. has surpassed a $3 trillion market value for the first time, making it the fifth company to achieve this milestone. The company's shares climbed after strong second-quarter earnings, driven by accelerating cloud-computing revenue. Amazon now joins Nvidia, Alphabet, Microsoft, and Apple in this elite group.

events.title: SiTime stock price target maintained at $800 by Stifel on AI demand

(NASDAQ:SITM), citing strong AI infrastructure demand from hyperscalers like Alphabet and Amazon, which is expected to drive SiTime's data center revenue. events.title: Oracle Shares Up 5.6% as Company Confronts $638 Billion Backlog Cash Challenge
events.summary: Oracle's stock rose 5.6% as the company navigates the challenge of converting its massive $638 billion performance obligations backlog into tangible cash flow. While customer prepayments and short-term financing covered 14.3% of its fiscal 2026 gross capital expenditure, Oracle recorded a negative free cash flow of $23.7 billion. The company anticipates needing $40 billion in debt and equity financing for fiscal 2027 and projects capital expenditures could reach $95 billion, with customers expected to reimburse $20 billion to $25 billion.

events.title: India Eyes More Tax Breaks for Electronics in Win For Apple
events.summary: India plans to extend tax breaks for foreign firms supplying machinery to local electronics manufacturers, including companies like Apple Inc. and Google. This move, which involves amendments to the Income Tax Act, will prolong tax exemptions for contract manufacturers until 2041, benefiting the production of mobile phones, laptops, tablets, and servers. The initiative is set to bolster domestic electronics manufacturing efforts.

events.title: Adeia earnings ahead: Can licensing wins offset sequential slide?
events.summary: Adeia Inc. is set to report its second-quarter earnings, with analysts anticipating sequential revenue decline despite recent high-profile licensing agreements with companies like AMD, Microsoft, and Google. The company faces the challenge of demonstrating that these deals can translate into sustained revenue growth, especially given an upcoming leadership transition and a push into semiconductor IP licensing. Investors will be keen to hear management's explanation for the expected revenue dip and updates on the CEO succession.

events.title: Oracle Corp Stock (ORCL) Moved Up by 5.09% on Aug 3: Facts Behind the Movement
events.summary: Oracle Corp (ORCL) stock rose by 5.09% on August 3, driven by increasing demand for its cloud infrastructure and AI compute clusters, as well as expanded multi-cloud partnerships. The company's strategic pivot towards high-performance AI and its ability to scale data centers with lower costs are attracting enterprise clients. Despite positive market sentiment and technical indicators, the article notes risks related to increased capital expenditures and the ongoing Cerner integration.

events.title: With SpaceX Earnings Looming, a Big Test for This ETF

This ETF, which aims to deliver 200% of SpaceX's daily returns, could see significant activity as investors watch for details on Starlink's performance and SpaceX's AI segment amidst broader market concerns about AI monetization. Analysts will be keen on subscriber growth for Starlink and any commentary on the AI business, which, while a smaller part of overall profits, is still substantial.

events.title: Apple Plans iPhone-to-Windows Copy and Paste in EU After Microsoft Request
events.summary: Apple is developing a new feature that will enable cross-device copy and paste functionality between iPhones and Windows PCs, a capability requested by Microsoft through Apple's EU interoperability system. This feature, expected to be fully implemented by fall 2027, will require a one-time user consent for paired devices and will likely first launch in the European Union, potentially expanding worldwide later. It addresses current limitations where clipboard synchronization from an iPhone to a PC is restricted due to app foreground requirements.

Ameren plans to update its long-term growth expectations and financing plans in the third quarter, incorporating these new sales trends and generation resource needs.

events.title: Alphabet’s stock splits: History & prospects explained
events.summary: Alphabet (Google) has split its stock twice, in 2014 and 2022, primarily to make shares more accessible to retail investors and for employee stock options and acquisitions. The company has three classes of shares: Class A (GOOGL) with one vote, Class B for founders/insiders with ten votes, and Class C (GOOG) with no voting rights. Given the current stock price of around $300, it is unlikely to split its shares again soon, as past splits occurred when the stock was trading at significantly higher price points.

events.title: AMD and Texas Instruments Are Getting Support From the Same Trend

For Texas Instruments, the firm anticipates significant recovery in industrial, automotive, and personal electronics demand, coupled with the company's manufacturing capacity, to drive market share gains.

events.title: SAP SE Stock (SAP) Moved Up by 3.20% on Aug 3: A Full Analysis

events.title: Jon Grays Says Impatience About AI Returns Is 'a Little Misplaced'
events.summary: Jon Gray, President and COO at Blackstone, believes that the impatience surrounding returns on AI investments is "a little misplaced" and that applications of AI will take time to fully manifest. Despite investor skepticism and turbulent performance in AI-linked stocks, Gray emphasized that AI will become a "new operating system for the global economy," with Blackstone heavily investing in the AI buildout through data centers and other related sectors. He noted that the firm's private equity portfolio growth in the second quarter was largely driven by these AI investments, which he expects to continue growing significantly.

events.title: Who owns your AI data? Navigate security and proprietary risks
events.summary: CIOs face increasing confusion regarding AI data ownership, particularly concerning input, training, output, and retrieval context data. This article emphasizes the critical need for robust governance and security measures, highlighting how vague vendor contracts and different AI tool types (public vs. enterprise, open source vs. open weight) can complicate data ownership and lead to proprietary knowledge loss. It advises CIOs to demand specific contractual protections, including no training on customer data, short retention windows, data isolation, and clear output ownership rights, to mitigate risks and avoid unforeseen costs.

This change, while introducing some execution risk, is expected to support Waystar's growth and financial discipline as it scales its AI-powered platform and integrates the Iodine acquisition.

However, Intel must prove its advanced nodes can meet performance and yield requirements to capitalize on TSMC's supply bottleneck and rising prices.

events.title: The FCC Mulls Banning China-Sourced Optical Transceivers, Threatening Innolight’s 27% Global Market Share As Coherent And Lumentum Prepare To Pounce

The FCC may instead focus on banning upgrades to next-gen transceivers to allow US companies to ramp up production, as part of a broader strategy to de-risk critical supply chains.

events.title: SK hynix, Sandisk set first HBF standard for AI memory
events.summary: SK hynix and Sandisk have established the first industry standard for High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) memory, aiming to bridge the performance and capacity gap between high bandwidth memory (HBM) and solid-state drives (SSDs) for AI applications. This new standard defines HBF products with capacities up to 512 gigabytes and bandwidths ranging from 0.4 to 3 terabytes per second, placing it strategically between conventional memory and storage in AI server data hierarchies. The companies also plan to introduce their tenth-generation, 375-layer 4D NAND technology to begin mass production of high-performance enterprise SSDs next year, targeting power-intensive AI data centers.

The move comes as Western Union aims to grow its digital and consumer services amid a shrinking core business.

events.title: Earnings call transcript: Chatham Lodging beats Q2 2026 estimates as demand rises
events.summary: Chatham Lodging Trust reported strong Q2 2026 results, exceeding Wall Street's profit and revenue estimates, driven by a significant increase in business travel, particularly in Silicon Valley and the Midwest. The company saw RevPAR rise by 3.3% in Q2, accelerating to 9.7% in July, and increased its full-year guidance by approximately 20% since the start of 2026. Management attributed this success to strategic acquisitions, strong operational performance, effective cost control, and share repurchases, while maintaining a cautious outlook for the second half due to geopolitical uncertainties.

events.title: Shopify Inc Stock (SHOP) Moved Up by 3.20% on Aug 4: What Investors Need To Know
events.summary: Shopify Inc.'s stock (SHOP) rose by 3.20% due to strong quarterly earnings, a strategic focus on enterprise-level merchants via Shopify Plus, and successful integration of AI tools. Positive macroeconomic factors like cooling inflation and resilient consumer spending also contributed to investor confidence in growth-oriented tech stocks. The company's disciplined cost management and technological leadership have led to revised price targets from brokerage firms.

events.title: CISA Orders Federal Agencies to Patch Actively Exploited N-able N-central Flaw Within 72 Hours
events.summary: CISA has issued an emergency directive requiring federal agencies to patch an actively exploited authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-18577) in N-able's N-central platform by August 6th. This flaw allows attackers to gain full administrative control of MSP consoles, potentially leading to widespread compromise of client environments. The vulnerability is a result of an incomplete prior fix, and while most cloud-hosted instances are patched, many self-hosted servers remain vulnerable.

events.title: Uber Earnings Prediction Market Preview: What Will Dara Khosrowshahi Say?
events.summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE: UBER) is set to report its second-quarter earnings, with analysts expecting 83 cents per share on $14.2 billion in revenue. Prediction markets like Kalshi are active, forecasting topics CEO Dara Khosrowshahi might address, including the "Delivery Hero" acquisition, "Waymo" competition, regulatory issues, and the integration of "Nvidia" hardware for its autonomous fleet. The market is keenly focused on Uber's strategy for autonomous vehicles, seeing it as Khosrowshahi's key challenge.

events.title: NiSource earnings in focus as data center strategy faces test By Investing.com
events.summary: NiSource Inc. is set to report its second-quarter earnings, with analysts expecting a decline in EPS but a rise in revenue. Investor focus will be heavily on the Midwest utility's data center strategy, including the economic implications of its 3.8 gigawatts of capacity with hyperscale customers and an additional 5 GW in the pipeline. Operating cost pressures from storm-related expenses, labor costs, and increased interest expenses are also key concerns for the upcoming earnings report.

events.title: Cousins boosts Endeavor’s future Austin HQ with $32M preferred equity investment
events.summary: Cousins Properties has made a $31.5 million preferred equity investment in Endeavor Real Estate's 5th & Walsh project in Downtown Austin, which will house Endeavor's new headquarters. This investment comes as Cousins divests from older office properties, including Research Plaza V, and shifts its focus to newer developments in its Austin portfolio. The 5th & Walsh mixed-use development is expected to be completed in 2028 and is already 55 percent preleased.

events.title: SAP SE Stock (SAP) Closed Up by 3.21% on Aug 4: Drivers Behind the Movement
events.summary: SAP SE's stock rose by 3.21% on August 4th, driven by strong investor confidence in its cloud-first strategy and successful implementation of generative AI. The company's expanding cloud backlog and improved operating profit, coupled with a stabilizing interest rate environment, have led analysts to revise price targets upward. While technical indicators suggest both buy signals and overbought conditions, the market is primarily focused on SAP's fundamental strength and long-term growth prospects in enterprise software and AI.

events.title: DigitalOcean tops second quarter expectations amid surging AI demand
events.summary: DigitalOcean Holdings Inc. surpassed analyst expectations for its second-quarter earnings and raised its third-quarter guidance, largely driven by a significant surge in demand for its artificial intelligence services. The company's revenue increased by 29% year-over-year, with annualized recurring revenue from AI customers jumping 212%. DigitalOcean introduced several new AI features, including Inference Engine, and announced plans to expand its computing capacity to support continued growth.

events.title: Elon Musk says SpaceX will build exclusively with Nvidia, touts space-based AI servers
events.summary: During its first-ever earnings call, SpaceX CEO Elon Musk announced that the company will exclusively use Nvidia's systems for its AI services, highlighting the "Vera Rubin architecture" as the best AI computer. SpaceX plans to launch Nvidia's Vera Rubin NVL72 rackscale system both on Earth and in space as part of its Starmind satellite program, with space-based data centers offering advantages like reduced land requirements and cooling issues. This announcement follows SpaceX's successful earnings report, which exceeded expectations with significant growth in AI revenues due to cloud service agreements and increased Grok and X subscriptions.

events.title: Aberdeen Group plc Buys ProQR Therapeutics NV (PRQR) -- Shares L
events.summary: Aberdeen Group plc significantly increased its stake in ProQR Therapeutics NV (PRQR) by purchasing over 5.6 million shares at $1.86 each, bringing their total ownership to 6.33%. Despite ProQR's low GF-Score and financial challenges typical of early-stage biopharmaceutical companies, GuruFocus assesses it as "Modestly Undervalued" with an 11% discount to its intrinsic value, suggesting a long-term conviction in its RNA therapeutics platform. This move by Aberdeen highlights a strategy to identify undervalued opportunities in high-growth sectors, particularly in the risky but potentially rewarding biopharmaceutical space.

events.title: Enlight Renewable Energy (NASDAQ: ENLT) lifts 2026 outlook after 55% Q2 surge
events.summary: Enlight Renewable Energy reported robust second-quarter 2026 results, with total revenues and income surging 55% to $210 million and Adjusted EBITDA increasing 67% to $160 million. The company has raised its 2026 guidance for both revenues and Adjusted EBITDA, signaling strong expected growth. Its project portfolio expanded by 4.6% to 43.1 FGW, with mature assets projected to generate an annual revenue run rate of $2.2-$2.3 billion by year-end 2028, underpinned by significant project financing and strategic expansion into energy storage and new markets.

events.title: Enlight Renewable Energy Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
events.summary: Enlight Renewable Energy reported strong Q2 results with significant increases in revenue, adjusted EBITDA, and net income, leading to an upward revision of its full-year 2026 guidance. The company highlighted successful project conversions, favorable market trends driven by AI and electrification, and strategic expansions in the U.S. and European storage markets. Enlight is also developing a substantial data-center pipeline, indicating future growth beyond its current renewable energy projects.

events.title: State regulator reviews OpenAI-Georgia Power contract
events.summary: Georgia's Public Service Commission is reviewing a contract between OpenAI and Georgia Power for electricity supply to a new $20 billion data center in Effingham County. The contract, which will provide 3.2 gigawatts of power, is expected to take effect on August 14. Commissioner Peter Hubbard has expressed concerns about potential loopholes regarding payment accountability and the lack of clean energy provisions in the agreement, while his opponent Fitz Johnson maintains existing protections are sufficient.

events.title: Earnings To Watch: The Real Brokerage (REAX) Reports Q2 Results Tomorrow
events.summary: The Real Brokerage (REAX) is set to report its Q2 earnings before the bell on Thursday. The company missed revenue expectations last quarter but beat EPS estimates. Analysts expect a 21% year-on-year revenue growth for this quarter, slowing from the previous year, and the company rarely misses Wall Street's revenue estimates.

events.title: Dte Energy Company (0I6Q) Q1 2026 Earnings Report - Results, Call & Slides
events.summary: DTE Energy (GB:0I6Q) reported its Q1 2026 earnings, missing EPS estimates at $1.95 against a consensus of $2.01, but beating revenue expectations with $5.30 billion. The company reiterated its full-year operating EPS guidance, aiming for the high end, and projected 6-8% operating EPS growth through 2030, with utilities comprising 93% of earnings. Key drivers include significant data center agreements with Oracle and Google, expected to bring substantial customer affordability benefits and incremental capital investments, alongside material reliability improvements and strategic funding plans.

events.title: Booking Holdings Inc (BKNG) (Q2 2026) Earnings Call Highlights: Strong Beat Across All Metrics, ...
events.summary: Booking Holdings Inc (BKNG) reported a strong Q2 2026, exceeding guidance across all key financial metrics, including room nights, gross bookings, revenue, and adjusted EBITDA. The company highlighted successful AI initiatives leading to cost reductions and improved customer satisfaction, alongside growth in "Connected Trip" transactions. Despite strong performance, challenges included the negative impact of the Middle East conflict on long-haul travel, increased marketing expenses, and pressure on SEO.

events.title: Datadog Inc Stock (DDOG) Moved Down by 16.96% on Aug 6: Facts Behind the Movement
events.summary: Datadog Inc (DDOG) stock dropped by 16.96% on August 6 due to a slowdown in enterprise consumption, reduced full-year financial guidance, and increasing operational costs. The company's core revenue streams were affected by large clients optimizing cloud spend rather than adding new services, alongside intense market competition and macroeconomic pressures. Investors are concerned about narrowing operating margins and the unproven impact of AI initiatives on the bottom line.

events.title: Eastern Bank Has $2.97 Million Position in Verizon Communications Inc. $VZ
events.summary: Eastern Bank significantly reduced its stake in Verizon Communications Inc. (NYSE:VZ) by 68.3% in the second quarter, selling 151,090 shares and retaining 70,246 shares valued at approximately $2.97 million. This move comes as Verizon reported strong quarterly earnings, beating EPS estimates, despite a slight revenue dip. The company maintains a "Hold" rating from analysts with an average price target of $50.84, while facing potential long-term competition from SpaceX's satellite mobile offerings.

events.title: Edgestream Partners L.P. Sells 80,539 Shares of Enphase Energy, Inc. $ENPH
events.summary: Edgestream Partners L.P. significantly reduced its stake in Enphase Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ:ENPH) by 83.2%, selling 80,539 shares and retaining 16,283 shares valued at approximately $616,000. This move comes as institutional investors collectively own 72.12% of the company. Enphase Energy recently reported quarterly EPS of $0.46, slightly missing consensus estimates, and revenue of $291.85 million, which exceeded expectations despite a 19.6% year-over-year decline.

events.title: Earnings call transcript: TPG tops Q2 2026 estimates as shares rise 5.5%
events.summary: TPG Inc. reported stronger-than-expected Q2 2026 results, with adjusted EPS of $0.82 and revenue of $628.19 million, surpassing Wall Street estimates. The alternative asset manager saw fee-related revenue jump 27% and fee-related earnings climb 43%, leading to a 5.54% rise in shares. The company also raised $16 billion in capital during the quarter and remains on track to exceed $50 billion in capital raised for 2026, driven by strong performance across its private equity, credit, real estate, and wealth products.

events.title: Salesforce previews plans to deliver newly authorized ‘AI agents’ across DOD
events.summary: Salesforce's Agentforce 360 platform has received Department of Defense (DOD) Impact Level 5 (IL5) authorization, allowing it to securely process Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and unclassified National Security Systems (NSS) data. This approval marks a significant expansion for Salesforce into the U.S. defense and intelligence markets, with early applications including the Army Human Resources Command. The company's new Missionforce unit is focused on delivering AI agents that assist human operators and automate tasks, aiming to accelerate innovation within the DOD.

events.title: OPPG ETF Profile: Dividends, Returns (AMEX:OPPG)
events.summary: The WisdomTree GeoAlpha Opportunities Fund (OPPG) is an actively managed ETF investing in companies globally that are expected to benefit from geopolitical shifts, fiscal/monetary policy changes, technological innovation, and shifting consumer preferences. It has assets under management of $1.85 million, an expense ratio of 0.58%, and pays annual dividends with a yield of 0.53%. The fund's primary sector exposures are Technology Services and Consumer Durables, with most assets located in North America.

events.title: People Incorporated Q2 2026 slides: digital margins hit 26%
events.summary: People Incorporated reported strong Q2 2026 results, with digital revenue growing 6% year-over-year and digital adjusted EBITDA expanding 18% to $74 million, achieving 26% margins. The company, formerly IAC Inc., also highlighted its strategic pivot towards a focused entity comprising its digital publishing business and a significant stake in MGM Resorts International, with management asserting a substantial valuation discount relative to its sum-of-parts value. Despite headwinds in search traffic, People Inc. is diversifying its digital revenue streams through non-session-based revenue growth and new initiatives, while actively deleveraging and executing share repurchases.

events.title: eBay Earnings Prediction Market Preview: Will Pokémon and GameStop Be a Topic?
events.summary: This article previews eBay's upcoming second-quarter earnings report, focusing on predictions from Kalshi and Polymarket regarding key topics and financial outcomes. The market predicts stronger GMV than eBay's guidance, which could impact Ryan Cohen's argument about the company's user growth.

events.title: Alphabet Inc. $GOOGL is Insight Holdings Group LLC's 5th Largest Position
events.summary: Insight Holdings Group LLC has increased its stake in Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL) by 1.3%, making it their fifth-largest position with holdings valued at $82.7 million. Despite positive outlooks from analysts, the company faces risks from regulatory challenges, insider selling, and significant AI infrastructure investments.

events.title: NiSource Q2 2026 earnings: Profit declines but guidance remains unchanged
events.summary: NiSource (NYSE: NI) reported a decline in Q2 2026 GAAP and adjusted net income and EPS, primarily due to weather-related costs and NIPSCO work-continuity expenses. Despite the profit decline, the company reaffirmed its full-year adjusted EPS guidance, supported by efficiency initiatives and regulatory mechanisms. NiSource is also advancing its data center strategy with contracts from Amazon and Alphabet, which are expected to contribute to its long-term capital plan and rate-base growth.

events.title: Edgewell Personal Care (NYSE:EPC) Misses Q2 CY2026 Revenue Estimates
events.summary: Edgewell Personal Care (NYSE:EPC) reported Q2 CY2026 results, missing Wall Street's revenue expectations with sales up 1.7% year-on-year to $570.1 million, despite an analyst consensus of $577.1 million. However, the company exceeded non-GAAP profit estimates with $0.72 per share, and also beat adjusted EBITDA and full-year guidance estimates. The company's organic revenue growth of 1.1% marked a positive turnaround after several quarters of decline, but its operating margin decreased.

events.title: Angi Inc (ANGI) Earnings Forecast: Future EPS & Revenue Growth Estimates

events.title: Janus Henderson Group PLC Has $11.38 Million Stock Holdings in Adeia Inc. $ADEA
events.summary: Janus Henderson Group PLC significantly increased its stake in Adeia Inc. (NASDAQ:ADEA) by 948.3% in the first quarter, now owning 473,438 shares valued at approximately $11.38 million. The company recently reported better-than-expected Q2 EPS, renewed a licensing agreement with Google, and raised its long-term annual revenue outlook, contributing to a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating from analysts.

events.title: Apple, Alphabet, JB Hunt And Howmet Aerospace: CNBC’s ‘Final Trades’
events.summary: CNBC's "Final Trades" featured discussions on Apple, Alphabet, JB Hunt, and Howmet Aerospace. Analysts provided their views and recent financial performance for these companies, including Apple's better-than-expected Q3 results but lower Q4 guidance, Alphabet's strong Q2 revenue, and JB Hunt's Q2 earnings beat. Investment professionals also shared their recommendations, with Joshua Brown remaining long on Apple, Rob Sechan endorsing Howmet Aerospace, and Jim Lebenthal picking Alphabet.

events.title: Alphabet Inc. $GOOG Stock Position Increased by GAMMA Investing LLC
events.summary: GAMMA Investing LLC significantly increased its stake in Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOG) by 9.8% during the second quarter, bringing its total holdings to 135,341 shares valued at $47.8 million. This increase comes as Alphabet reported strong quarterly earnings, beating analyst expectations with $9.11 EPS and $119.8 billion in revenue, along with declaring a $0.22 per share quarterly dividend. Despite a consensus "Buy" rating from analysts and positive sentiment around its cloud growth and AI advancements, concerns persist regarding heavy AI infrastructure spending and potential regulatory risks.

events.title: Alphabet’s stock drops as Google loses another key AI executive
events.summary: Alphabet's stock declined after the company announced a significant change in its artificial intelligence division. Jeff Dean, Google's chief scientist and one of its earliest employees, is departing after 27 years to start a public-benefit corporation focused on machine learning. Dean was instrumental in shaping Google's AI strategy, and his departure comes amid investor concerns about Google trailing AI rivals like Anthropic and OpenAI.

events.title: Earnings call transcript: TeraWulf posts wider Q2 2026 loss, shares slip
events.summary: TeraWulf Inc. reported a wider-than-expected loss for Q2 2026, posting an adjusted loss per share of $1.94 against an analyst estimate of 25 cents, despite revenue rising to $44.77 million. The company is transitioning from bitcoin mining to high-performance computing (HPC) leasing, with HPC revenue now accounting for about 71% of total revenue. Management highlighted new contract wins and strong liquidity, enabling funding for projects without near-term equity issuance, while acknowledging challenges with large accounting losses and rising interest costs.

events.title: NiSource Announces Second Quarter Results
events.summary: NiSource (NYSE: NI) announced its second quarter 2026 results, reaffirming its non-GAAP consolidated adjusted EPS guidance for 2026 at $2.02-$2.07 and a 9%-10% compound annual growth rate through 2033. The company is executing a $28.6 billion capital investment plan for 2026-2030, which includes $7.6 billion dedicated to strategic data center infrastructure investments. NiSource also highlighted advancing its data center strategy with regulatory approvals for agreements with Amazon and Alphabet, creating value for customers.

events.title: CLSK Stock In Focus After CleanSpark Signs $6.6B AI Data Center Lease In First HPC Deal Ahead Of Earnings Report
events.summary: CleanSpark (CLSK) has signed a significant 20-year, $6.6 billion high-performance computing (HPC) data center lease, marking its largest entry into AI infrastructure and a strategic diversification from Bitcoin mining. This deal precedes the company's third-quarter earnings report, where analysts expect a loss of $0.33 per share and revenue of $142 million. In July, CleanSpark mined 586 Bitcoin and held 13,931 Bitcoin, with an operational hashrate of 50 EH/s.

events.title: Earnings call transcript: NiSource Q2 2026 EPS miss weighs on shares
events.summary: NiSource (NYSE:NI) reported mixed Q2 2026 results, with adjusted EPS missing Wall Street estimates at $0.16 versus $0.23, while revenue of $1.28 billion exceeded forecasts. The earnings miss, attributed to higher operating costs from severe weather and workforce expenses, led to a 4.99% decline in premarket trading. Despite the shortfall, the company reaffirmed its full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance and highlighted a growing data center pipeline as a key long-term growth driver, expecting $1.4 billion in customer bill reductions from Amazon and Alphabet contracts.

events.title: Alphabet shares fall 5% as AI pioneer Jeff Dean exits in major shakeup
events.summary: Alphabet's shares dropped 5% following the departure of AI pioneer Jeff Dean, who is leaving to launch a new AI startup called Discovery Loop, focused on automating scientific discovery. This exit is part of a larger leadership restructuring within Alphabet's AI divisions, with Google DeepMind CTO Koray Kavukcuoglu being promoted to Senior Vice President. Alphabet will also be a founding investor and cloud computing partner for Dean's new venture.

events.title: EPAM Systems earnings up next: Large deal pipeline in focus
events.summary: EPAM Systems is set to release its second-quarter results, with analysts expecting modest sequential improvement. Investors will be closely watching for progress on its growing pipeline of large deals and how its strategic AI partnerships translate into revenue growth or margin expansion. Despite recent AI-related recognition and partnerships, the company's stock trades at a forward P/E ratio suggesting limited near-term growth, which the upcoming report will test.

events.title: The next chapter of our AI momentum
events.summary: Sundar Pichai and Demis Hassabis announced significant changes within Google DeepMind to accelerate AI development and focus on AGI. Demis Hassabis will transition to Chair of Google DeepMind and Chief Scientist of Alphabet, dedicating more attention to the future of AGI and leading Isomorphic Labs. Koray Kavukcuoglu will step up as SVP of Google DeepMind, overseeing Gemini model development and Frontier AI research.

events.title: Global Business Travel Group Inc (GBTG) Earnings Forecast: Future EPS & Revenue Growth Estimates
events.summary: This article provides an earnings forecast for Global Business Travel Group Inc (GBTG), highlighting its current earnings forecast score, average price target, and analyst ratings. events.title: Tech travel drives 41% gain at Sunnyvale hotels
events.summary: Chatham Lodging Trust reported a 41% gain at its Sunnyvale Residence Inn hotels, attributing the rise to increased business travel from Silicon Valley tech companies like Nvidia and Google. Revenue per available room increased by 7% in Q2 and 26% in July across the company's four Silicon Valley properties, highlighting a strong recovery in corporate travel.

events.title: TeraWulf’s HPC leasing revenue jumps 52%, widening lead over bitcoin mining
events.summary: TeraWulf's high-performance computing (HPC) lease revenue significantly increased by 52% quarter-over-quarter, reaching $31.9 million and now accounts for 71% of the company's total Q2 revenue. This growth highlights a strategic shift away from its traditional bitcoin mining operations towards contracted HPC services. Despite reporting a net loss driven by warrant adjustments, the company is expanding its data center capacity and secured a major 20-year lease with Anthropic.

events.title: Alphabet Inc Class A Stock (GOOGL) Moved Down by 3.53% on Aug 5: A Full Analysis
events.summary: Alphabet Inc Class A (GOOGL) stock declined by 3.53% on August 5th, driven by increasing regulatory scrutiny, high capital expenditure for generative AI, and softening enterprise advertising budgets. Federal regulators are considering structural remedies following antitrust rulings, raising concerns about Google's core advertising revenue. The substantial investment in AI infrastructure is pressuring profit margins, while a broader economic slowdown is impacting digital ad spending forecasts.

events.title: Alphabet Inc Class C Stock (GOOG) Moved Down by 3.59% on Aug 5: A Full Analysis
events.summary: Alphabet Inc Class C (GOOG) shares fell by 3.59% on August 5th, attributed to macroeconomic volatility, ongoing antitrust concerns, and rising AI capital expenditures. events.title: TeraWulf rating affirmed at BB- by S&P Global Ratings
events.summary: S&P Global Ratings affirmed TeraWulf Inc.'s ’BB-’ issuer credit rating but revised its outlook from positive to stable. This change follows TeraWulf’s announcement of a 20-year, $19 billion lease with Anthropic for a new 401-megawatt AI data center, with the revised outlook reflecting uncertainty regarding financing, construction risks, and Anthropic's unrated credit profile. S&P highlighted that the Hawesville facility is expected to significantly contribute to TeraWulf's revenue by 2029, with potential for rating improvements if construction is completed and Google LLC provides a backstop.

events.title: Goldman Sachs stock doubles from 'Liberation Day' lows, with more room to run: BofA
events.summary: Goldman Sachs stock has more than doubled since President Trump's "Liberation Day" announcement in April 2025, driven by strong performance in turbulent financial markets. The bank's impressive second-quarter earnings, fueled by trading and dealmaking, along with a resurgence in M&A and IPO activity and the AI boom, contribute to the positive outlook.

events.title: Celldex Therapeutics stock hits 52-week high at $40.30

events.summary: Gartner's 2026 Magic Quadrant for Cloud-Native Application Platforms highlights the increasing importance of AI-agent support in platform evaluations. events.title: Silicon Labs Delivers its Lowest-Power Bluetooth LE SoC
events.summary: Silicon Labs has introduced the BG2B, a Series 2 Bluetooth Low Energy (LE) wireless SoC, designed to extend battery life and enhance capabilities for battery-powered IoT devices. The BG2B offers the lowest power consumption in Silicon Labs’ Bluetooth LE portfolio, with improved efficiency across various operational modes. It also integrates advanced security features like Secure Vault, along with numerous peripherals such as CAN-FD, LED drivers, and dual ADCs, reducing bill-of-materials cost and enabling new applications in smart homes, industrial monitoring, and vehicle diagnostics.

events.title: Oracle Multi-VM Autonomous Database lands on Exadata systems
events.summary: Oracle has expanded its Exadata Cloud at Customer service with a new Multi-VM Autonomous Database feature, allowing organizations to run both autonomous and non-autonomous Oracle databases on the same hardware. This virtualization, based on KVM hypervisor clustering, addresses customer demand for integrated database environments and simplifies data management while accelerating transitions to the cloud. The move provides a full self-service database cloud option within customer data centers, enhancing flexibility and potentially reducing costs.

events.title: BlackRock, Inc. Expands Stake in Zentalis Pharmaceuticals (ZNTL) with Strategic Share Addition

events.title: Netflix Trades at 21 Times Forward Earnings After Falling 43% From Its High. Here's How That Multiple Compares to Where the Stock Traded the Last 2 Times It Fell This Far.

This article analyzes how Netflix's valuation and investor sentiment changed during its previous two major pullbacks in 2011 and late 2021, and questions whether the current P/E of 21 indicates a bottom for the stock given ongoing challenges. Historically, the P/E ratio has fallen lower during previous downturns before a recovery.

events.title: National Vision Holdings (EYE) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript

events.title: Amazon to expand drone deliveries to suburbs
events.summary: Amazon plans to significantly expand its Prime Air drone delivery service to suburban areas in at least five more US states, including Chicago, Atlanta, Cleveland, and Syracuse, by the end of 2026. This expansion aims to increase drone delivery availability to nearly 500 cities and towns, reaching 30 million people. The service, which charges $2.99 ($4.99 for non-Prime members), is a major step in turning the decade-old research project into a commercial reality, with Amazon retrofitting warehouses to support the operation.

events.title: Broadcom shares drop 2.3% after Marvell announces TPU deal with Google

events.title: Douglas Elliman (NYSE:DOUG) stock in focus as it launches Elius AI platform
events.summary: Douglas Elliman (NYSE:DOUG) has launched Elius, an AI-driven market-intelligence platform developed with Google Cloud, aimed at transforming its property data into actionable insights. This strategic move highlights the company's efforts to integrate traditional real estate brokerage with modern technology to enhance decision-making, streamline operations, and improve client services. The initiative is a significant pivot for the luxury residential real estate brand, positioning data as a key competitive differentiator in a challenging and cyclical market.

events.title: Foresight Evaluates Expansion Into New Technology Markets, Including AI-Based Technologies, Cybersecurity and Data Centers
events.summary: Foresight is exploring an expansion into new technology markets such as AI-based technologies, cybersecurity, and data centers. The move indicates Foresight's interest in adapting to the rapidly evolving technological landscape.

events.title: Why Berkshire Hathaway Just Made Alphabet Its Third-Largest Bet
events.summary: Berkshire Hathaway significantly increased its stake in Alphabet during Q2 2026, investing approximately $17 billion through a private placement and open-market purchases, making it Berkshire's third-largest U.S. equity holding. This move, personally initiated by Warren Buffett, marks a departure from Berkshire's usual tech investment caution and ends a 14-quarter streak of net stock selling. The investment is specifically tied to Alphabet's $84.75 billion AI infrastructure capital raise, signaling a direct bet on the accelerating demand for AI services.

events.title: Amazon (AMZN) Sees Bigger AWS Growth, but Rising Competition Could Pressure Returns
events.summary: Eagle Capital Management, in its Q2 2026 investor letter, highlighted Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN), acknowledging its strong AWS growth and leading market position. While the firm recognizes Amazon's potential, it expresses concerns about rising competition in the cloud industry and suggests that other AI stocks might offer greater upside potential with less downside risk. Despite Amazon's robust Q1 2026 revenue growth, Eagle Capital is diversifying its portfolio beyond the most crowded AI trades, favoring a strategy that performs across multiple outcomes.

events.title: Marvell gives Google option to buy $12.2 billion stake in custom chip deal
events.summary: Marvell Technology will partner with Google to develop custom chips for Google's AI infrastructure, offering Google the option to purchase up to a $12.2 billion stake in Marvell. This deal enables Google to diversify its custom chip partnerships beyond Broadcom and secure alternatives to Nvidia's GPUs for AI inference, capitalizing on the increasing demand for in-house chips. The warrant's full exercise is contingent on Google meeting specific purchasing targets through 2033.

events.title: Berkshire Reshapes Its Stock Portfolio: ETFs in Focus
events.summary: Berkshire Hathaway significantly increased its Alphabet stake by 83% in Q2 2026, making Alphabet its third-largest holding. The company also increased its stake in Delta Air Lines, initiated a new position in D.R. Horton, and significantly increased holdings in Lennar and Macy’s, while reducing stakes in Capital One, Nucor, Bank of America, and Kroger. These portfolio adjustments represent Berkshire's biggest stock-buying quarter in years, alongside substantial share buybacks.

events.title: Marvell Technology Shares up 9% Premarket After Co Enters Deal With Google for Custom Chips

events.title: Does FactSet’s AI Push With Google Cloud And Capital Returns Alter The Bull Case For FDS?
events.summary: FactSet Research Systems Inc. recently declared a quarterly dividend of US$1.16 per share, while also increasing its focus on AI initiatives, including a partnership with Google Cloud. The article examines whether these AI advancements and capital returns will significantly change FactSet's investment outlook, particularly in light of potential AI-related disruptions and rising technology costs. While the dividend reinforces a consistent capital-return strategy, the company's long-term narrative heavily relies on its AI execution and ability to offset sector pressures.

events.title: AI Analysis Confirms Years of Investor Concerns Over Corporate America’s Woke, Liberal Politics
events.summary: The American Conservative Values ETF (ACVF) released an analysis comparing responses from four independent AI systems (Claude, Grok, Copilot, and ChatGPT) to identify large-cap S&P 500 companies perceived as "woke" or "liberal" by conservatives. The analysis found a strong consensus, with 15 companies appearing on at least two lists and seven (Walt Disney, BlackRock, Alphabet, Meta, Amazon, Nike, and Starbucks) appearing on all four, aligning with ACVF's investor surveys and boycott list. This independent confirmation validates long-standing concerns of conservative investors regarding corporate political leanings.

events.title: HN Original: From Search Box to Travel Advisor: IHG’s Kim Smith on the Next Phase of AI Booking
events.summary: IHG has launched an AI-powered conversational search on IHG.com and the IHG One Rewards app, moving beyond traditional keyword searches to allow guests to describe their travel needs in natural language. Kim Smith, SVP of Digital Direct Channels at IHG, explains that this initiative, in partnership with Google, aims to make the booking journey more intuitive and personalized, ultimately transforming hotel discovery and guest interaction into a more advised experience. The company is focusing on rich, accurate, and structured hotel content to ensure discoverability in an AI-driven landscape and is testing the beta to understand guest behavior and measure success through engagement and conversion.

events.title: Buy, Hold or Sell Tesla Stock Ahead of Cybercab Launch?
events.summary: Tesla is preparing to launch its Cybercab in Austin, TX, a purpose-built autonomous vehicle designed to be a major growth engine for its robotaxi ambitions. While Tesla's EV and energy businesses show growth in deliveries, profitability is declining, and significant spending on future technologies like autonomy, AI, and robotics is impacting free cash flow. The article suggests that while Tesla's long-term potential is compelling, the stock is currently a "Hold" due to uncertain short-term profitability and unproven scalability of its new ventures, especially when compared to competitors like Waymo and Zoox.

events.title: CBL & Associates Properties (CBL) Faces A Fair Value Gap As 2026 Guidance Improves
events.summary: CBL & Associates Properties (CBL) has seen improved sales and net income, alongside new 2026 earnings guidance, leading to strong share price performance. Investors are encouraged to assess the risks and rewards themselves.

The focus is on Alphabet potentially offering a new buy point, alongside an acknowledgment of remaining flaws.

events.title: 3 considerations for health systems adopting AI chatbots
events.summary: As health systems increasingly adopt AI chatbots, they must consider three key factors: proactively engaging with AI given the prevalence of commercial tools, carefully integrating AI with existing provider workflows to ensure value and uptake, and differentiating their offerings from Big Tech's commercial AI to capture high-intent users. The article emphasizes that health systems need to maintain patient relationships and trust, using AI to supplement care rather than replace direct provider interaction.

events.title: Google’s founders didn’t market test Alphabet’s name before launching the now $1.9 trillion juggernaut. Here's the advice Steve Jobs gave Larry Page
events.summary: The article discusses how Google's founders, Larry Page and Sergey Brin, did not market test the name "Alphabet" for their parent company, despite its eventual $1.9 trillion valuation. It highlights advice Steve Jobs gave Larry Page in 2011 about focusing on a few key products, a philosophy Page initially adopted but later diverged from with Alphabet's broader vision. The piece also details Page and Brin's current net worth and their roles in Alphabet.

events.title: Microsoft signs offtake deal for wastewater-based carbon removal
events.summary: Microsoft has entered into an offtake agreement with climate tech startup Crew Carbon for wastewater-based carbon removal. Crew Carbon's technology, developed at Yale, enhances wastewater alkalinity to permanently remove carbon dioxide emitted by wastewater treatment plants by converting biogenic CO2 into stable bicarbonate ions. This deal is part of Microsoft's ongoing carbon removal efforts, despite previous reports of a pause in their CDR purchases.

events.summary: Apple's conservative approach to AI spending has positioned its stock as a hedge against market volatility, setting it apart from other "Magnificent Seven" tech companies. While rivals pour billions into AI infrastructure, Apple's lower capital expenditure has led to strong financial performance and outperformance of its peers, especially after a period of investor anxiety over high AI costs. The company recently reported record June quarter revenues and regained its position as the world's most valuable company.

events.title: Polestar Automotive Holding UK (NASDAQ:PSNY) Stock Price Down 6.4% - Here's What Happened

events.title: GitHub outage had users weighing options, but finding few
events.summary: A recent major GitHub outage, which affected critical services like GitHub Actions and Copilot for several hours, left many users frustrated and contemplating alternatives. However, the deep integration of GitHub Actions and the significant effort required for migration mean that switching platforms is not a viable option for most companies, despite the recurring reliability issues. While new competitors are emerging with agentic DevSecOps services, GitHub's substantial market lead and ecosystem make it difficult for users to transition away.

events.title: FactSet Affirms Dividend as Google Cloud AI Pact Fuels Rally Debate
events.summary: FactSet Research Systems has affirmed a quarterly cash dividend of $1.16 per share, to be paid on September 17, 2026. This announcement comes as the company's shares have seen a significant rally, driven by its AI partnership with Google Cloud, despite being down over the past year. Analysts project strong revenue and earnings growth by fiscal 2029, though risks related to rising cloud/AI costs and a soft banking environment exist.

events.title: AI sycophancy: When leaders are told what they want to hear
events.summary: This article discusses AI sycophancy, where AI systems align with users' beliefs rather than providing objective analysis, posing a risk to leadership decision-making. It highlights how this bias can negatively impact strategic, personnel, and investment decisions, and offers strategies for leaders to identify and combat it. The author emphasizes the importance of scrutinizing assumptions and framing prompts as questions to ensure balanced AI insights.

events.title: AppLovin vs. Kratos Defense: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
events.summary: This article compares AppLovin (APP) and Kratos Defense & Security Solutions (KTOS) as technology stock investments for 2026, highlighting their different business models, financial performance, and risk profiles. AppLovin specializes in AI-driven ad tech with high margins and strong cash flow, while Kratos focuses on defense hardware, benefiting from government contracts. Despite AppLovin's faster growth, the author recommends Kratos for long-term growth due to its reliable government client and the increasing demand for its defense technologies in a geopolitically unstable environment.

events.title: Marvell: With Google Chip Deal, Firm Landing the White Whale
events.summary: Marvell Technology Inc. has secured a commercial agreement with Google for custom chips, including AI inference accelerators, which significantly expands Marvell's long-term AI growth potential. The firm views this as a strong endorsement of Marvell's custom silicon strategy and anticipates more details during Marvell's upcoming July-quarter results report.

events.title: Alphabet Stock Surged When Its AI Spending Found Customers
events.summary: Alphabet's stock significantly outperformed the market and its peers over the past year, returning 69.6% compared to the S&P 500's 20.3%. This surge is attributed to its AI spending finding customers, particularly in Google Cloud, which saw 82% revenue growth and improved operating margins. Despite increased capital expenditure and pressure on free cash flow, the company's strategic investments in AI are proving successful.

events.title: Taboola gains NBC News display ads in first deal beyond native
events.summary: Taboola has announced an expanded partnership with NBC News, where its Realize platform will manage global programmatic display advertising on NBCNews.com and TODAY.com. This marks Taboola's first deal to extend beyond native advertising into broader display business for a publisher. The agreement comes as NBCUniversal prepares for a corporate split from Comcast, making direct revenue lines more valuable, and positions Taboola as a strategic partner for publishers aiming to move ad budgets from walled gardens to the open web.

This global push could challenge YouTube's market dominance but may also bring scrutiny over censorship and data security, similar to issues faced by TikTok.

The firm believes that concerns about search have largely been addressed and that Alphabet is poised for multiple expansion as operating profits in cloud computing scale beyond current expectations. This optimism is tempered by the acknowledgment that a deceleration in cloud growth would pose a greater risk than new search competition.

events.title: Buy, Hold or Sell Tesla Stock Ahead of Cybercab Launch?
events.summary: Tesla is preparing to launch its Cybercab robotaxi service in Austin, TX, by the end of the month, aiming to generate high-margin recurring revenue. Despite record EV deliveries and growth in FSD subscriptions, Tesla's margins are declining, and massive capital expenditures for future ambitions are negatively impacting free cash flow, making its stock a "Hold" rather than a "Buy" or "Sell" for existing long-term investors.

events.title: US Treasury Just Doubled Size Of Liquidity Support Buyback — El-Erian Says Move Is More About Possibility Of Broader Deployment Of Yield Curve Control
events.summary: The U.S. Treasury has doubled the size of its liquidity support buyback operations for longer-dated nominal coupon securities from $2 billion to at least $4 billion per operation, effective September 9, 2026. This move led to a fall in longer-term Treasury yields. Economist Mohamed El-Erian suggests this action is less about the immediate buyback and more about the potential broader deployment of yield curve control, especially as Treasury yields have been spiking due to factors like the Middle East conflict, AI-related borrowing, and a high fiscal deficit.

It offers greater reliability, observability, and compliance for repeatable queries, addressing limitations of traditional methods like URL size constraints and operational ambiguity.

events.title: Tap to pay with Google Pay is coming to Walmart.

events.title: Truth Social is selling faster access to Trump posts. Is that legal?
events.summary: Trump Media's new "Truth API" service offers paying clients expedited access to former President Trump's social media posts, including official announcements that could move markets, raising significant legal and ethical concerns. Critics argue this practice gives preferential access to critical government information, potentially violating the First and Fifth Amendments, and differs from other news services because the information originates directly from a former president who stands to profit. A federal lawsuit has been filed, and congressional Democrats are proposing legislation to block such pay-for-access schemes for government employees' communications.

events.title: Finally, Apple Pay is coming to WalMart stores in the US
events.summary: Walmart is finally expanding its payment options to include tap-to-pay services like Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Wallet, after years of resisting NFC-based payments in favor of its own Walmart Pay system. This change, which begins on August 24, will be implemented across Walmart and Sam's Club stores by the end of 2026, with gas stations following in 2027. Walmart had previously focused on its QR code-based Walmart Pay to track consumer spending.

They are crucial for building trusted data foundations for enterprise AI and for implementing a governance-first strategy.

events.title: Walmart to accept Apple Pay and Google Pay at all U.S. stores
events.summary: Walmart announced it will begin accepting Apple Pay and Google Pay, along with other contactless payments, at all of its U.S. stores and Sam's Club locations by the end of 2026, with fuel stations following by mid-2027. This decision marks a significant reversal for the retailer, which previously favored its own payment systems. The move aims to expand customer choice and streamline the checkout process, making Walmart's payment options align more closely with other major retailers.

events.title: Walmart makes major change to how you can pay in stores
events.summary: Walmart is implementing a major change to its payment systems, introducing tap-to-pay technology at all U.S. Walmart and Sam's Club stores by the end of 2026, with expansion to fuel stations by mid-2027. This update will support options like Apple Pay and Google Pay, as well as digital versions of Walmart, Sam's Club, and OnePay cards. This move aims to provide customers with more choice and convenience, making Walmart one of the last major retailers to adopt this widely used payment method.

events.title: Walmart will let customers use Apple Pay after holding out for more than a decade. Why it finally caved
events.summary: Walmart, after resisting for over a decade, has finally announced support for Apple Pay and other tap-to-pay methods. The retail giant previously avoided these mobile payment options to protect customer data for their own profiling and tried to launch a competing service, CurrentC, which ultimately failed. Walmart eventually developed its own platform, Walmart Pay, before finally adopting broader mobile payment support.

events.title: Apple Users Beware: ChatGPT’s Newest Mac Feature Could Pose a Major Privacy Risk
events.summary: OpenAI's new ChatGPT feature for Mac allows it to control Apple's Messages app, offering convenience for personal use by searching, drafting, and sending replies. However, this integration requires granting ChatGPT deep access to contacts and disk storage, raising significant privacy and security concerns, especially for business users who might unwittingly expose sensitive company data. The article highlights a potential conflict with Apple's privacy-centric reputation, as users give a powerful AI chatbot free rein over their communications and data.

events.title: GTA 6 makers subpoena Microsoft, Discord in hunt for leakers
events.summary: Take-Two Interactive Software Inc., the parent company of Rockstar Games, has subpoenaed Microsoft and Discord in an effort to identify the leaker known as Cyberleek, who has been posting Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay footage. The subpoenas confirm the legitimacy of some leaked content and request identifying information for Discord users and GitHub repositories associated with the leaks. The leaker has overshadowed Rockstar's promotional plans and continues to release content while promoting a memecoin.

events.title: PG&E shopping SoMa substation as AI companies fight for computing power

The 21,000-square-foot property, marketed by JLL, is seen as ideal for AI, advanced computing, or R&D due to its unique power entitlement and proximity to major AI firms. San Francisco has experienced a significant surge in AI-related leases, with companies occupying over 7.1 million square feet citywide.

events.title: YouTube offers creators millions to not work With Netflix
events.summary: YouTube is reportedly offering significant financial incentives to its top creators to exclusively upload content to its platform, aiming to prevent them from simultaneously working with Netflix. This strategy is a direct response to Netflix's efforts to recruit popular YouTubers and feature their content, which YouTube believes dilutes its viewership and value to advertisers. The move signifies an escalation in the competition between the two streaming giants for creator talent and audience attention.
